import type { ReviewView } from '../types'
import type { ShortcutAction } from './keymap'

export const PANE_ID = 'diff-review'
export const PANE_TITLE = 'Review'

// The transcript and the prompt keep the left third, the review takes the rest.
export const PANE_SHARE_OF_TERMINAL = 2 / 3
// Under this width the gutter (ask button, line numbers, marker) leaves too little room to read code.
export const MIN_PANE_COLUMNS = 60
// Narrower, the file list leaves the code the whole width and opens over it on demand.
export const TWO_COLUMNS_MIN_WIDTH = 120
export const DEFAULT_FILE_LIST_WIDTH = 50
export const MIN_FILE_LIST_WIDTH = 24
export const MIN_DIFF_WIDTH = 40
// Each half of the side-by-side view needs about as much room as the narrowest unified diff.
export const SPLIT_VIEW_MIN_DIFF_WIDTH = 140
export const COMMIT_PANEL_MAX_LINES = 8
// What the header holds besides its tiles: the view tabs, the buttons and a little of the location.
export const HEADER_COLUMNS_WITHOUT_TILES = 142
export const WHEEL_TICK_ROWS = 3
export const ANSWER_PULSE_MS = 600
export const WORKING_TREE_POLL_MS = 5000
export const CONTEXT_RADIUS_ROWS = 6
export const DEFAULT_DIFF_CONTEXT_LINES = 3
export const DIFF_CONTEXT_STEP_LINES = 20
// A context wider than any file shows the whole file, its changes in place.
export const WHOLE_FILE_CONTEXT_LINES = 1000000
// Only the characters of a Button's label take a click: a row's label is padded with spaces past any pane width, and
// its clipped box cuts it, so the whole row answers a click and not just the name in it.
export const ROW_CLICK_TARGET_LENGTH = 400

export const VIEW_ORDER: readonly ReviewView[] = ['uncommitted', 'pr', 'commits']
export const VIEW_LABELS: Record<ReviewView, string> = { uncommitted: 'Uncommitted', pr: 'Pull Request', commits: 'Commits' }
export const VIEW_SHORTCUTS: Record<ReviewView, ShortcutAction> = {
  uncommitted: 'uncommittedView',
  pr: 'pullRequestView',
  commits: 'commitsView',
}

// Element keys: the focus, close and redirect rules recognise elements by these prefixes.
export const QUESTION_INPUT_KEY_PREFIX = 'question-'
export const REPLY_INPUT_KEY_PREFIX = 'reply-'
export const ASK_BUTTON_KEY_PREFIX = 'ask-'
export const LINE_NUMBER_BUTTON_KEY_PREFIX = 'line-'
export const DISMISS_THREAD_KEY_PREFIX = 'dismiss-'
export const CANCEL_QUESTION_KEY = 'cancel-question'
export const DICTATE_QUESTION_KEY = 'dictate-question'
export const FILE_FILTER_KEY = 'file-filter'
export const WATCH_FIELD_KEY = 'watch-term'
// The search bar frames its field, so that it reads as the place to type.
export const WATCH_BAR_ROWS = 3
// The anchor of the thread the commit button opens: no line of any diff carries it.
export const COMMIT_THREAD_ANCHOR_KEY = 'commit'
export const DIVIDER_KEY = 'file-divider'
export const FILE_BUTTON_KEY_PREFIX = 'file-'
export const DIRECTORY_BUTTON_KEY_PREFIX = 'directory-'
export const ASK_ON_LINE_KEY = 'ask-on-line'
// The keyboard rests on a hidden button drawn first in the pane: the engine keeps the focus by position, so a button
// drawn after threads or files would drift as they come and go. Enter on it asks about the cursor's line.
export const CURSOR_LINE_FOCUS_KEY = 'cursor-line'
export const ADDRESS_GITHUB_THREAD_KEY_PREFIX = 'address-github-thread-'
export const PULL_REQUEST_OVERVIEW_KEY = 'pr-overview'
export const HELP_CLOSE_KEY = 'help-close'

export const QUESTION_FOCUS_RETRY_MS = 120
// A file just marked viewed stays listed this long while viewed files are hidden, so the click does not make it vanish.
export const VIEWED_FILE_HIDE_DELAY_MS = 1500
// A session attached from another terminal (claude attach) or reached through Remote Control sends the person's
// prompts unstamped or as the bridge's: they are the person's own all the same.
export const PERSON_PROMPT_ORIGINS: readonly string[] = ['composer', 'unclassified', 'bridge']

export const BASE_REF_CANDIDATES = ['origin/main', 'origin/master', 'origin/develop', 'main', 'master']
export const GIT_TIMEOUT_MS = 15000
// A push may run the repository's pre-push hook, tests included.
export const GIT_PUSH_TIMEOUT_MS = 180000
// The push button asks for a second press within this delay, so a stray click pushes nothing.
export const PUSH_CONFIRM_DELAY_MS = 4000
export const PUSHED_NOTICE_MS = 4000
export const BROWSER_OPENERS = ['xdg-open', 'open']
export const GH_TIMEOUT_MS = 20000

export const FILE_LIST_WIDTH_STORE_KEY = 'fileListWidth'
export const SPLIT_VIEW_STORE_KEY = 'isSplitViewPreferred'
export const FILE_LIST_COLLAPSED_STORE_KEY = 'isFileListCollapsed'
export const THREADS_STORE_KEY_PREFIX = 'threads'
export const MAX_SAVED_THREADS_PER_BRANCH = 100
export const VIEWED_COMMITS_STORE_KEY_PREFIX = 'viewedCommits'
export const EMOJI_STORE_KEY = 'githubEmojiCharacters'
export const EMOJI_CACHE_DURATION_MS = 7 * 24 * 3600 * 1000

import type { KeyboardLayout } from '../types'

export type ShortcutAction =
  | 'uncommittedView'
  | 'pullRequestView'
  | 'commitsView'
  | 'previousView'
  | 'nextView'
  | 'previousFile'
  | 'nextFile'
  | 'markViewedAndNext'
  | 'focusFileFilter'
  | 'clearFileFilters'
  | 'toggleDirectoryFold'
  | 'toggleFileListCollapse'
  | 'previousLine'
  | 'nextLine'
  | 'previousHunk'
  | 'nextHunk'
  | 'moreContext'
  | 'wholeFile'
  | 'toggleSplitView'
  | 'askOnLine'
  | 'replyOnLine'
  | 'previousThread'
  | 'nextThread'
  | 'toggleThreadResolved'
  | 'openOnGitHub'
  | 'stageCurrentFile'
  | 'stageAllChanges'
  | 'commitStaged'
  | 'toggleHelp'
  | 'watchSelection'
  | 'nextWatchedMatch'
  | 'previousWatchedMatch'

export type ShortcutGroup = 'Views' | 'Files' | 'Lines' | 'Watch' | 'Threads' | 'git' | 'Other'

type ShortcutDefinition = {
  action: ShortcutAction
  group: ShortcutGroup
  description: string
  defaultKeys: (layout: KeyboardLayout) => readonly string[]
}

// Up, left, down and right sit on z q s d on an AZERTY keyboard and on w a s d on a QWERTY one. A layout that could
// not be read keeps both bound.
const upKeys = (layout: KeyboardLayout) => ({ azerty: ['z'], qwerty: ['w'], unknown: ['z', 'w'] })[layout]
const leftKeys = (layout: KeyboardLayout) => ({ azerty: ['q'], qwerty: ['a'], unknown: ['q', 'a'] })[layout]
const fixed = (key: string) => () => [key]

export const SHORTCUTS: readonly ShortcutDefinition[] = [
  { action: 'uncommittedView', group: 'Views', description: 'Uncommitted changes', defaultKeys: fixed('1') },
  { action: 'pullRequestView', group: 'Views', description: 'Pull request', defaultKeys: fixed('2') },
  { action: 'commitsView', group: 'Views', description: 'Commits', defaultKeys: fixed('3') },
  { action: 'previousView', group: 'Views', description: 'Previous view', defaultKeys: leftKeys },
  { action: 'nextView', group: 'Views', description: 'Next view', defaultKeys: fixed('d') },
  { action: 'previousFile', group: 'Files', description: 'Previous file', defaultKeys: upKeys },
  { action: 'nextFile', group: 'Files', description: 'Next file', defaultKeys: fixed('s') },
  { action: 'markViewedAndNext', group: 'Files', description: 'Mark viewed on GitHub, go to the next unviewed', defaultKeys: fixed('y') },
  { action: 'focusFileFilter', group: 'Files', description: 'Filter the files (Enter goes back to the diff)', defaultKeys: fixed('i') },
  { action: 'clearFileFilters', group: 'Files', description: 'Clear the filters, every file listed again', defaultKeys: fixed('5') },
  { action: 'toggleDirectoryFold', group: 'Files', description: "Fold or unfold the file's directory", defaultKeys: fixed('0') },
  { action: 'toggleFileListCollapse', group: 'Files', description: 'Collapse the file list behind a bar, or pin it beside the code', defaultKeys: fixed('9') },
  { action: 'previousLine', group: 'Lines', description: 'Line above', defaultKeys: fixed('k') },
  { action: 'nextLine', group: 'Lines', description: 'Line below', defaultKeys: fixed('j') },
  { action: 'previousHunk', group: 'Lines', description: 'Previous hunk (@@ block)', defaultKeys: fixed('b') },
  { action: 'nextHunk', group: 'Lines', description: 'Next hunk (@@ block)', defaultKeys: fixed('f') },
  { action: 'moreContext', group: 'Lines', description: 'More context around the changes', defaultKeys: fixed('u') },
  { action: 'wholeFile', group: 'Lines', description: 'The whole file, changes in place', defaultKeys: fixed('l') },
  { action: 'toggleSplitView', group: 'Lines', description: 'Side by side or unified (wide diff)', defaultKeys: fixed('t') },
  { action: 'askOnLine', group: 'Lines', description: 'Ask about the line (Enter too), address a GitHub thread', defaultKeys: fixed('c') },
  { action: 'replyOnLine', group: 'Lines', description: 'Reply in the thread of the line', defaultKeys: fixed('r') },
  { action: 'watchSelection', group: 'Watch', description: 'Search all changes for the text selected with the mouse, or type it', defaultKeys: fixed('8') },
  { action: 'nextWatchedMatch', group: 'Watch', description: 'Next occurrence of the watched term, across files', defaultKeys: fixed('7') },
  { action: 'previousWatchedMatch', group: 'Watch', description: 'Previous occurrence of the watched term', defaultKeys: fixed('6') },
  { action: 'previousThread', group: 'Threads', description: 'Previous thread', defaultKeys: fixed('p') },
  { action: 'nextThread', group: 'Threads', description: 'Next thread', defaultKeys: fixed('n') },
  { action: 'toggleThreadResolved', group: 'Threads', description: 'Resolve or unresolve the GitHub thread', defaultKeys: fixed('x') },
  { action: 'openOnGitHub', group: 'Other', description: 'Open the comment, commit or PR on GitHub', defaultKeys: fixed('o') },
  { action: 'stageCurrentFile', group: 'git', description: 'git add the file', defaultKeys: fixed('g') },
  { action: 'stageAllChanges', group: 'git', description: 'git add everything', defaultKeys: fixed('e') },
  { action: 'commitStaged', group: 'git', description: 'Have Claude commit what git add staged', defaultKeys: fixed('4') },
  { action: 'toggleHelp', group: 'Other', description: 'This help', defaultKeys: fixed('h') },
]

export type Keymap = Record<ShortcutAction, readonly string[]>

export function keymapOf(layout: KeyboardLayout): Keymap {
  return Object.fromEntries(SHORTCUTS.map(shortcut => [shortcut.action, shortcut.defaultKeys(layout)])) as Keymap
}

export function shortcutsOfGroup(group: ShortcutGroup): readonly ShortcutDefinition[] {
  return SHORTCUTS.filter(shortcut => shortcut.group === group)
}

export const SHORTCUT_GROUPS: readonly ShortcutGroup[] = ['Views', 'Files', 'Lines', 'Watch', 'Threads', 'git', 'Other']
files.hooks/view/model.ts:
import type {
  ChangedFile,
  CommitGraphLine,
  CommitRequest,
  ErrorNotice,
  CommitSummary,
  GitHubReviewThread,
  DiffRow,
  PullRequestSummary,
  PushState,
  ReviewThread,
  ReviewView,
  StageState,
  ViewedState,
} from '../../types'
import {
  COMMIT_THREAD_ANCHOR_KEY,
  FILE_FILTER_KEY,
  QUESTION_INPUT_KEY_PREFIX,
  REPLY_INPUT_KEY_PREFIX,
  SPLIT_VIEW_MIN_DIFF_WIDTH,
  TWO_COLUMNS_MIN_WIDTH,
  WATCH_FIELD_KEY,
} from '../constants'
import { viewedPathsToHide, visibleFilesOf } from '../file-filter'
import { cursorStopsOf, firstChangeStop } from '../cursor'
import { countLinesToView, countViewedFiles, gitHubThreadNavigationEntries } from '../github-review'
import type { Keymap, ShortcutAction } from '../keymap'
import { buildFileLines, clampFileListWidth, computePaneGeometry, scrolledByLines, topLineFollowingRow } from '../layout'
import type { DiffScrollPosition } from '../layout'
import type { PaneGeometry } from '../layout'
import { splitMarkdownBlocks } from '../markdown'
import { anchorKeyOf, fileAnchorPrefixOf, openThreadsByPath, threadsInReadingOrder } from '../questions'
import { groupFilesByDirectory } from '../git-parsing'
import { pairRowsSideBySide, splitIndexOfRow } from '../split-rows'
import { commitBarRows } from './commit-bar'
import { commitMessageRows } from './commit-message'
import type { CommitMessageInput } from './commit-message'
import type { CommitBarInput } from './commit-bar'
import { LINES_TO_VIEW_TILE_LABEL } from './drawings'
import type { HeaderTile } from './drawings'
import { estimatedRowHeights } from './row-height'
import type { PaneInput } from './pane'
import type { ExplorerActions, GitHubPage, QuestionState, ThreadNavigation } from './types'

export type ExplorerSnapshot = {
  view: ReviewView
  repositoryRoot: string | null
  repositoryWebUrl: string | null
  branch: string | null
  baseRef: string | null
  baseBranchName: string | null
  uncommittedFileCount: number
  stagedFileCount: number
  commitRequest: CommitRequest
  commitThread: ReviewThread | null
  branchCommitCount: number
  unpushedCommitShas: string[]
  pushState: PushState
  commitListOffset: number | null
  errorNotices: ErrorNotice[]
  helpScrolledLines: number
  followedThreadId: string | null
  isLoading: boolean
  loadError: string | null
  commits: CommitSummary[]
  commitGraph: CommitGraphLine[]
  gitHubReviewThreads: GitHubReviewThread[]
  expandedGitHubThreadIds: string[]
  selectedCommitSha: string | null
  selectedCommitMessage: string | null
  files: ChangedFile[]
  selectedFilePath: string | null
  isOverviewShown: boolean
  diffRows: DiffRow[]
  pullRequest: PullRequestSummary | null
  viewedStateByPath: Record<string, ViewedState>
  stageStateByPath: Record<string, StageState>
  fileFilter: string
  watchedTerm: string
  isWatchFieldOpen: boolean
  watchedMatchCountByPath: Record<string, number>
  isWholeFileByPath: Record<string, boolean>
  isNoiseShown: boolean
  isViewedHidden: boolean
  recentlyViewedPaths: string[]
  foldedDirectories: string[]
  isFileDrawerOpen: boolean
  isFileListCollapsed: boolean
  isSplitViewPreferred: boolean
  keymap: Keymap
  isHelpShown: boolean
  cursorRowIndex: number | null
  focusedElementKey: string | null
  fileListWidth: number
  fileListOffset: number
  diffOffset: number
  diffSkippedLines: { path: string; rowIndex: number; lines: number } | null
  threads: ReviewThread[]
  anchorWithOpenInput: string | null
  questionFieldNumber: number
  questionDraft: string
  hasQuestionHadKeyboard: boolean
  armedAnchorKey: string | null
  currentThreadId: string | null
  answerPulseFrame: number
}

export type PaneSurface = { bodyRows: number; bodyColumns: number; isPaneFocused: boolean }

export type PaneModel = {
  paneInput: PaneInput
  geometry: PaneGeometry
  fileLineIndexByPath: Record<string, number>
  fileLineCount: number
  commitLineCount: number
  scrolledRowCount: number
  isOverviewShown: boolean
  isSplitView: boolean
  cursorRowIndex: number | null
  isScrollingPastEnd: boolean
  // Filled while a file's diff is shown, empty on the overview.
  diffRowHeights: number[]
  // Where the diff should stand to keep the followed answer's end in sight, when it does not stand there yet.
  followPosition: DiffScrollPosition | null
}

export function buildPaneModel(snapshot: ExplorerSnapshot, surface: PaneSurface, actions: ExplorerActions): PaneModel {
  const { view, files, selectedFilePath, selectedCommitSha, threads } = snapshot
  const pullRequest = view === 'pr' ? snapshot.pullRequest : null
  const viewedStateByPath = pullRequest ? snapshot.viewedStateByPath : {}
  const isOverviewShown = pullRequest !== null && snapshot.isOverviewShown
  const overviewBlocks = pullRequest && isOverviewShown ? splitMarkdownBlocks(pullRequest.overviewMarkdown) : []
  const hasStageActions = view === 'uncommitted' && files.length > 0

  // A one-letter shortcut would fire on the letters typed into a question or a reply: none is bound meanwhile.
  const focusedElementKey = snapshot.focusedElementKey ?? ''
  const isTyping =
    focusedElementKey.startsWith(QUESTION_INPUT_KEY_PREFIX) ||
    focusedElementKey.startsWith(REPLY_INPUT_KEY_PREFIX) ||
    focusedElementKey === FILE_FILTER_KEY ||
    focusedElementKey === WATCH_FIELD_KEY
  const isWatchBarShown = snapshot.watchedTerm !== '' || snapshot.isWatchFieldOpen
  // Each shortcut a drawn button carries is noted, so the ones left over get a stand-in (see renderIdleShortcuts).
  const claimedActions = new Set<ShortcutAction>(['previousFile', 'nextFile', 'previousView', 'nextView'])
  const hotkeyOf = (action: ShortcutAction) => {
    if (isTyping) {
      return undefined
    }
    claimedActions.add(action)
    return snapshot.keymap[action][0]
  }

  const questionState: QuestionState = {
    anchorWithOpenInput: snapshot.anchorWithOpenInput,
    // Escape or a click outside gives the keyboard back to the prompt: an empty question that had the keyboard then
    // stops being drawn. One just opened by a click while the prompt still held the keyboard stays.
    isQuestionFieldShown: surface.isPaneFocused || !snapshot.hasQuestionHadKeyboard || snapshot.questionDraft.trim() !== '',
    questionFieldKey: `${QUESTION_INPUT_KEY_PREFIX}${snapshot.questionFieldNumber}`,
    armedAnchorKey: snapshot.armedAnchorKey,
    isAnswerPulseLit: snapshot.answerPulseFrame % 2 === 0,
  }
  const isCommitBarShown =
    view === 'uncommitted' &&
    (snapshot.stagedFileCount > 0 || snapshot.commitRequest.state !== 'idle' || snapshot.commitThread !== null)
  const commitBar: CommitBarInput | null = isCommitBarShown
    ? {
        stagedFileCount: snapshot.stagedFileCount,
        commitRequest: snapshot.commitRequest,
        thread: snapshot.commitThread,
        isReplyArmed: snapshot.armedAnchorKey === COMMIT_THREAD_ANCHOR_KEY,
        isAnswerPulseLit: questionState.isAnswerPulseLit,
      }
    : null
  const selectedCommit = snapshot.commits.find(commit => commit.sha === selectedCommitSha)
  const commitMessage: CommitMessageInput | null =
    view === 'commits' && selectedCommit && snapshot.selectedCommitMessage !== null
      ? { commit: selectedCommit, message: snapshot.selectedCommitMessage }
      : null
  const fileAnchorPrefix = selectedFilePath ? fileAnchorPrefixOf(view, selectedCommitSha, selectedFilePath) : null
  const gitHubThreads = pullRequest ? snapshot.gitHubReviewThreads : []
  const gitHubThreadsOfFile = gitHubThreads.filter(thread => thread.path === selectedFilePath)
  const hasInlineContentInFile =
    gitHubThreadsOfFile.length > 0 ||
    (fileAnchorPrefix !== null &&
      [...threads.map(thread => thread.anchorKey), snapshot.anchorWithOpenInput, snapshot.armedAnchorKey].some(anchorKey =>
        (anchorKey ?? '').startsWith(fileAnchorPrefix),
      ))

  const isViewedHidden = pullRequest !== null && snapshot.isViewedHidden
  const shown = visibleFilesOf(files, {
    filter: snapshot.fileFilter,
    isNoiseShown: snapshot.isNoiseShown,
    hiddenPaths: isViewedHidden ? viewedPathsToHide(viewedStateByPath, snapshot.recentlyViewedPaths) : undefined,
  })
  const fileLines = buildFileLines(shown.files, pullRequest !== null, snapshot.foldedDirectories)
  const threadsOfScreen = threadsInReadingOrder([...threads, ...gitHubThreadNavigationEntries(gitHubThreads)], {
    view,
    commitSha: view === 'commits' ? selectedCommitSha : null,
    orderedPaths: groupFilesByDirectory(shown.files).flatMap(group => group.files.map(file => file.path)),
    hasOverview: pullRequest !== null,
  })
  const resolvedGitHubThreadIds = new Set(gitHubThreads.filter(thread => thread.isResolved).map(thread => thread.id))
  const gitHubThreadIds = new Set(gitHubThreads.map(thread => thread.id))
  const openThreadCountByPath = Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(openThreadsByPath(threadsOfScreen, resolvedGitHubThreadIds)).map(([path, threadsOfFile]) => {
      const gitHubCount = threadsOfFile.filter(thread => gitHubThreadIds.has(thread.id)).length
      return [path, { claudeCount: threadsOfFile.length - gitHubCount, gitHubCount }]
    }),
  )
  const currentThreadIndex = threadsOfScreen.findIndex(thread => thread.id === snapshot.currentThreadId)
  const threadNavigation: ThreadNavigation = {
    position: currentThreadIndex === -1 ? null : currentThreadIndex,
    count: threadsOfScreen.length,
    currentGitHubThread: gitHubThreads.find(thread => thread.id === snapshot.currentThreadId) ?? null,
  }
  const diffWidth =
    !snapshot.isFileListCollapsed && surface.bodyColumns >= TWO_COLUMNS_MIN_WIDTH
      ? surface.bodyColumns - clampFileListWidth(snapshot.fileListWidth, surface.bodyColumns)
      : surface.bodyColumns
  const canSplitView = diffWidth >= SPLIT_VIEW_MIN_DIFF_WIDTH
  const splitRows = canSplitView && snapshot.isSplitViewPreferred ? pairRowsSideBySide(snapshot.diffRows) : null
  const cursorStops = cursorStopsOf(snapshot.diffRows, splitRows)
  const cursorRowIndex =
    snapshot.cursorRowIndex !== null && cursorStops.includes(snapshot.cursorRowIndex)
      ? snapshot.cursorRowIndex
      : firstChangeStop(snapshot.diffRows, cursorStops)
  const hasLineShortcuts = !isOverviewShown && selectedFilePath !== null
  const scrolledRowCount = isOverviewShown ? overviewBlocks.length : (splitRows ?? snapshot.diffRows).length
  const isScrollingPastEnd = isOverviewShown || hasInlineContentInFile
  const isScrollingByLines = !isOverviewShown && selectedFilePath !== null
  const geometry = computePaneGeometry({
    bodyRows: surface.bodyRows,
    bodyColumns: surface.bodyColumns,
    view,
    hasLoadError: snapshot.loadError !== null,
    errorNoticeCount: snapshot.errorNotices.length,
    hasPullRequestLine: pullRequest !== null,
    commitLineCount: snapshot.commitGraph.length,
    requestedCommitListOffset: snapshot.commitListOffset,
    selectedCommitLineIndex: Math.max(
      0,
      snapshot.commitGraph.findIndex(line => !line.isBoundary && line.commit?.sha === selectedCommitSha),
    ),
    fileLineCount: fileLines.length,
    hasStageActions,
    commitBarRows: commitBar ? commitBarRows(commitBar, surface.bodyColumns) : 0,
    commitMessageRows: commitMessage ? commitMessageRows(commitMessage, surface.bodyColumns) : 0,
    hasNoiseNotice: shown.hiddenNoiseCount > 0 || snapshot.isNoiseShown,
    hasWatchBar: isWatchBarShown,
    requestedFileListWidth: snapshot.fileListWidth,
    requestedFileListOffset: snapshot.fileListOffset,
    scrolledRowCount,
    isScrollingPastEnd,
    isScrollingByLines,
    requestedDiffOffset: snapshot.diffOffset,
    hasLineShortcuts,
    isFileDrawerOpen: snapshot.isFileDrawerOpen,
    isFileListCollapsed: snapshot.isFileListCollapsed,
  })
  // The divider beside the file list is left out of the width too: a narrower guess only counts more lines.
  const diffContentWidth = diffWidth - 3
  const diffRowHeights =
    isScrollingByLines && selectedFilePath !== null
      ? estimatedRowHeights(snapshot.diffRows, splitRows, {
          view,
          selectedCommitSha,
          path: selectedFilePath,
          diffContentWidth,
          threads,
          gitHubThreads: gitHubThreadsOfFile,
          expandedGitHubThreadIds: snapshot.expandedGitHubThreadIds,
          currentThreadId: snapshot.currentThreadId,
          questionState,
        })
      : []
  const savedSkippedLines = snapshot.diffSkippedLines
  const firstShownRowHeight = diffRowHeights[geometry.diffOffset]
  const diffSkippedLines =
    savedSkippedLines !== null &&
    savedSkippedLines.path === selectedFilePath &&
    savedSkippedLines.rowIndex === geometry.diffOffset &&
    firstShownRowHeight !== undefined
      ? Math.min(savedSkippedLines.lines, firstShownRowHeight - 1)
      : 0
  const followedThread = threads.find(thread => thread.id === snapshot.followedThreadId)
  const followedRowIndex =
    followedThread && selectedFilePath !== null
      ? snapshot.diffRows.findIndex(row => anchorKeyOf(view, selectedCommitSha, selectedFilePath, row) === followedThread.anchorKey)
      : -1
  let followPosition: DiffScrollPosition | null = null
  if (followedRowIndex !== -1 && diffRowHeights.length > 0) {
    const followedScrolledIndex = splitRows ? splitIndexOfRow(splitRows, followedRowIndex) : followedRowIndex
    const currentTopLine = diffRowHeights.slice(0, geometry.diffOffset).reduce((total, height) => total + height, 0) + diffSkippedLines
    const followingTopLine = topLineFollowingRow(diffRowHeights, followedScrolledIndex, currentTopLine, geometry.visibleDiffRows)
    if (followingTopLine !== currentTopLine) {
      const totalLines = diffRowHeights.reduce((total, height) => total + height, 0)
      followPosition = scrolledByLines({ rowIndex: 0, skippedLines: 0 }, followingTopLine, diffRowHeights, totalLines - 1)
    }
  }
  const repositoryName = snapshot.repositoryRoot?.split('/').filter(Boolean).at(-1)
  const location = [
    snapshot.isLoading ? 'loading…' : null,
    repositoryName ? `\u{1F4C1} ${repositoryName}` : null,
    snapshot.branch ? `\u{1F33F} ${snapshot.branch}` : null,
    view !== 'uncommitted' && snapshot.baseRef ? `from ${snapshot.baseBranchName ?? 'base'} ${snapshot.baseRef.slice(0, 10)}` : null,
  ]
    .filter(part => part !== null && part !== '')
    .join('  │  ')

  const viewedCount = countViewedFiles(files.map(file => file.path), viewedStateByPath)
  const linesToView = countLinesToView(files, viewedStateByPath)
  const paneInput: PaneInput = {
    bodyRows: surface.bodyRows,
    bodyColumns: surface.bodyColumns,
    geometry,
    view,
    location,
    uncommittedFileCount: snapshot.uncommittedFileCount,
    branchCommitCount: snapshot.branchCommitCount,
    unpushedCommitShas: snapshot.unpushedCommitShas,
    pushState: snapshot.pushState,
    help: snapshot.isHelpShown ? { keymap: snapshot.keymap, scrolledLines: snapshot.helpScrolledLines } : null,
    loadError: snapshot.loadError,
    errorNotices: snapshot.errorNotices,
    pullRequest,
    viewedCount,
    linesToView,
    watchBar: isWatchBarShown ? { term: snapshot.watchedTerm, matchCountByPath: snapshot.watchedMatchCountByPath } : null,
    commitBar,
    commitMessage,
    headerTiles: headerTilesOf(files, pullRequest, viewedCount, linesToView, gitHubThreads),
    commitGraph: snapshot.commitGraph,
    commitCount: snapshot.commits.length,
    repositoryWebUrl: snapshot.repositoryWebUrl,
    gitHubPage: gitHubPageOf(
      snapshot,
      pullRequest,
      gitHubThreads.find(thread => thread.id === snapshot.currentThreadId),
    ),
    selectedCommitSha,
    hotkeyOf,
    idleShortcuts: isTyping ? null : { keymap: snapshot.keymap, claimedActions },
    fileList: {
      files,
      shownFileCount: shown.files.length,
      hiddenNoiseCount: shown.hiddenNoiseCount,
      fileFilter: snapshot.fileFilter,
      watchedMatchCountByPath: snapshot.watchedMatchCountByPath,
      isNoiseShown: snapshot.isNoiseShown,
      isViewedHidden,
      hasUnpushedCommits: snapshot.unpushedCommitShas.length > 0,
      fileLines,
      shownFileLines: fileLines.slice(geometry.fileListOffset, geometry.fileListOffset + geometry.visibleFileLines),
      fileListOffset: geometry.fileListOffset,
      visibleFileLines: geometry.visibleFileLines,
      selectedFilePath,
      isOverviewShown,
      pullRequest,
      viewedStateByPath,
      openThreadCountByPath,
      hasStageActions,
      stageStateByPath: view === 'uncommitted' ? snapshot.stageStateByPath : null,
      keymap: snapshot.keymap,
      isTyping,
      hotkeyOf,
      actions,
    },
    overview:
      pullRequest && isOverviewShown
        ? {
            pullRequest,
            blocks: overviewBlocks,
            blockOffset: geometry.diffOffset,
            visibleBlocks: geometry.visibleDiffRows,
            threads,
            questionState,
            threadNavigation,
            hotkeyOf,
            actions,
          }
        : null,
    diff: {
      view,
      selectedCommitSha,
      selectedFile: files.find(file => file.path === selectedFilePath),
      diffRows: snapshot.diffRows,
      splitRows,
      canSplitView,
      cursorRowIndex,
      hasLineShortcuts,
      isOnGitHubThread: threadNavigation.currentGitHubThread !== null,
      watchedTerm: snapshot.watchedTerm,
      canMarkViewed: selectedFilePath !== null && viewedStateByPath[selectedFilePath] !== undefined,
      keymap: snapshot.keymap,
      isWholeFile: selectedFilePath !== null && snapshot.isWholeFileByPath[selectedFilePath] === true,
      diffOffset: geometry.diffOffset,
      diffSkippedLines,
      visibleDiffRows: geometry.visibleDiffRows,
      threads,
      gitHubThreads: gitHubThreadsOfFile,
      expandedGitHubThreadIds: snapshot.expandedGitHubThreadIds,
      currentThreadId: snapshot.currentThreadId,
      questionState,
      threadNavigation,
      hotkeyOf,
      actions,
    },
    actions,
  }

  return {
    paneInput,
    geometry,
    fileLineIndexByPath: Object.fromEntries(
      fileLines.flatMap((fileLine, index) => (fileLine.kind === 'file' ? [[fileLine.file.path, index]] : [])),
    ),
    fileLineCount: fileLines.length,
    commitLineCount: snapshot.commitGraph.length,
    scrolledRowCount,
    isOverviewShown,
    isSplitView: splitRows !== null,
    cursorRowIndex,
    isScrollingPastEnd,
    diffRowHeights,
    followPosition,
  }
}

function headerTilesOf(
  files: ChangedFile[],
  pullRequest: PullRequestSummary | null,
  viewedCount: { viewed: number; total: number },
  linesToView: { addedLines: number; removedLines: number },
  gitHubThreads: GitHubReviewThread[],
): HeaderTile[] {
  const lineTotals = pullRequest
    ? { addedLines: pullRequest.additions, removedLines: pullRequest.deletions }
    : files.reduce(
        (totals, file) => ({ addedLines: totals.addedLines + (file.addedLines ?? 0), removedLines: totals.removedLines + (file.removedLines ?? 0) }),
        { addedLines: 0, removedLines: 0 },
      )
  const tiles: HeaderTile[] = [
    { kind: 'count', label: 'Files', value: String(files.length) },
    { kind: 'lines', label: 'Lines', ...lineTotals },
  ]
  if (pullRequest) {
    tiles.push(
      { kind: 'progress', label: 'Viewed', done: viewedCount.viewed, total: viewedCount.total },
      { kind: 'lines', label: LINES_TO_VIEW_TILE_LABEL, ...linesToView },
      { kind: 'count', label: 'Open threads', value: String(gitHubThreads.filter(thread => !thread.isResolved).length) },
    )
  }

  return tiles
}

// The page the GitHub shortcut opens: the review comment the keyboard went to, else the selected commit in the commits
// view or the pull request in its view.
function gitHubPageOf(
  snapshot: ExplorerSnapshot,
  pullRequest: PullRequestSummary | null,
  currentGitHubThread: GitHubReviewThread | undefined,
): GitHubPage | null {
  const firstCommentUrl = currentGitHubThread?.comments[0]?.url
  if (firstCommentUrl) {
    return { url: firstCommentUrl, description: 'comment' }
  }
  const selectedCommit = snapshot.commits.find(commit => commit.sha === snapshot.selectedCommitSha)
  if (snapshot.view === 'commits' && selectedCommit && snapshot.repositoryWebUrl) {
    return {
      url: `${snapshot.repositoryWebUrl}/commit/${selectedCommit.sha}`,
      description: `commit ${selectedCommit.shortSha}`,
    }
  }
  if (snapshot.view === 'pr' && pullRequest) {
    return { url: pullRequest.url, description: `PR #${pullRequest.number}` }
  }

  return null
}

import type { DiffRowKind } from '../../types'

export type ThemeMode = 'dark' | 'light'

export type Theme = {
  paneBackground: string | undefined
  panelBackground: string | undefined
  headerBackground: string | undefined
  border: string
  text: string
  heading: string
  muted: string
  lineNumber: string
  accent: string
  accentBorder: string
  // The file count while a filter hides some files, so a short list is not mistaken for the whole change.
  filtered: string
  activeTabBackground: string | undefined
  selectedBackground: string | undefined
  cursorBackground: string | undefined
  threadBackground: string | undefined
  hunk: string
  directory: string
  commitSha: string
  added: string
  removed: string
  addedRowBackground: string | undefined
  removedRowBackground: string | undefined
  gitHubThread: string
  gitHubThreadBorder: string
  gitHubThreadBackground: string | undefined
  watched: string
  watchedMatchBackground: string
  // Kept when the backgrounds go back to the terminal: the file drawer opens over the diff and needs its own surface.
  tileFill: string
}

const DARK_THEME: Theme = {
  paneBackground: '#111318',
  panelBackground: '#171a21',
  headerBackground: '#1c2029',
  border: '#2a2f3a',
  text: '#d5d9e0',
  heading: '#eef1f5',
  muted: '#7f8896',
  lineNumber: '#4b5363',
  accent: '#6cb6ff',
  accentBorder: '#2b4a6e',
  filtered: '#ffa657',
  activeTabBackground: '#16263a',
  selectedBackground: '#1d2533',
  cursorBackground: '#1d2a3c',
  threadBackground: '#141c28',
  hunk: '#56c2d6',
  directory: '#e0a96d',
  commitSha: '#e3b341',
  added: '#7ee2a8',
  removed: '#ff8f8f',
  addedRowBackground: '#11251b',
  removedRowBackground: '#2a1517',
  gitHubThread: '#b392f0',
  gitHubThreadBorder: '#3d3160',
  gitHubThreadBackground: '#1a1626',
  watched: '#e3b341',
  watchedMatchBackground: '#5c4813',
  tileFill: '#1c2029',
}

const LIGHT_THEME: Theme = {
  paneBackground: '#f6f5f1',
  panelBackground: '#ffffff',
  headerBackground: '#f0efe9',
  border: '#d9d7ce',
  text: '#2b2f36',
  heading: '#14171c',
  muted: '#646c78',
  lineNumber: '#9aa1ab',
  accent: '#0a5cc2',
  accentBorder: '#a9c7ee',
  filtered: '#a34200',
  activeTabBackground: '#e3eefc',
  selectedBackground: '#eaf1fb',
  cursorBackground: '#dde9fb',
  threadBackground: '#f2f7fe',
  hunk: '#0b6f80',
  directory: '#9a5b13',
  commitSha: '#8a5a00',
  added: '#1a7438',
  removed: '#b3261e',
  addedRowBackground: '#e7f5eb',
  removedRowBackground: '#fcebea',
  gitHubThread: '#7038c7',
  gitHubThreadBorder: '#cdb6f2',
  gitHubThreadBackground: '#f6f1fd',
  watched: '#8a5a00',
  watchedMatchBackground: '#fde58a',
  tileFill: '#f0efe9',
}

// Claude Code's light themes are named light-…; anything else, the terminal-following one included, counts as dark.
export function claudeCodeModeOf(claudeCodeTheme: unknown): ThemeMode {
  return typeof claudeCodeTheme === 'string' && claudeCodeTheme.startsWith('light') ? 'light' : 'dark'
}

export function themeModeOf(configuredTheme: unknown, claudeCodeTheme: unknown): ThemeMode {
  return configuredTheme === 'dark' || configuredTheme === 'light' ? configuredTheme : claudeCodeModeOf(claudeCodeTheme)
}

// Button labels, code and markdown keep the terminal's own text color, which suits Claude Code's theme: a pane forced
// to the other mode leaves every background to the terminal so that text stays readable, and keeps only its colors.
export function themeOf(configuredTheme: unknown, claudeCodeTheme: unknown): Theme {
  const mode = themeModeOf(configuredTheme, claudeCodeTheme)
  const theme = mode === 'light' ? LIGHT_THEME : DARK_THEME
  if (mode === claudeCodeModeOf(claudeCodeTheme)) {
    return theme
  }

  return Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(theme).map(([key, color]) => [key, key.endsWith('Background') ? undefined : color]),
  ) as Theme
}

export const ROW_MARKS = { hunk: '@@', context: ' ', added: '+', removed: '−' } as const

export function rowColorOf(theme: Theme, kind: DiffRowKind): string {
  return { hunk: theme.hunk, context: theme.muted, added: theme.added, removed: theme.removed }[kind]
}

export function rowBackgroundOf(theme: Theme, kind: DiffRowKind): string | undefined {
  return { hunk: undefined, context: undefined, added: theme.addedRowBackground, removed: theme.removedRowBackground }[kind]
}

import { fileNameOf } from '../git-parsing'

const FILE_TYPE_BADGES: ReadonlyArray<{ extensions: string[]; badge: string; color: string }> = [
  { extensions: ['php'], badge: 'php', color: '#8892bf' },
  { extensions: ['ts', 'tsx', 'mts', 'cts'], badge: 'ts', color: '#3d8fd6' },
  { extensions: ['js', 'jsx', 'mjs', 'cjs'], badge: 'js', color: '#e8d44d' },
  { extensions: ['json'], badge: '{}', color: '#cbcb41' },
  { extensions: ['md', 'mdx'], badge: 'md', color: '#5fa8d3' },
  { extensions: ['sh', 'bash', 'zsh'], badge: '$_', color: '#89e051' },
  { extensions: ['yml', 'yaml'], badge: 'yml', color: '#e06c75' },
  { extensions: ['css', 'scss', 'sass'], badge: '#', color: '#c678dd' },
  { extensions: ['html', 'twig', 'vue', 'svelte'], badge: '<>', color: '#e5804f' },
  { extensions: ['py'], badge: 'py', color: '#4b8bbe' },
  { extensions: ['go'], badge: 'go', color: '#00add8' },
  { extensions: ['xml', 'xlf', 'xliff'], badge: '<>', color: '#c0965c' },
  { extensions: ['sql'], badge: 'sql', color: '#d7a65f' },
  { extensions: ['lock'], badge: 'lck', color: '#7f848e' },
]

export function fileTypeBadgeOf(path: string): { badge: string; color: string } {
  const fileName = fileNameOf(path)
  const extension = fileName.includes('.') ? fileName.slice(fileName.lastIndexOf('.') + 1).toLowerCase() : ''
  const known = FILE_TYPE_BADGES.find(entry => entry.extensions.includes(extension))

  return known ? { badge: known.badge, color: known.color } : { badge: '··', color: '#7f848e' }
}

files.types/index.d.ts:
export type ReviewView = 'uncommitted' | 'pr' | 'commits'

export type ChangedFile = {
  path: string
  addedLines: number | null
  removedLines: number | null
  isUntracked: boolean
  // Created or deleted by the change; absent, the file was modified.
  creation?: 'created' | 'deleted'
}

export type DiffRowKind = 'hunk' | 'context' | 'added' | 'removed'

export type DiffRow = { kind: DiffRowKind; oldNumber: number | null; newNumber: number | null; text: string; language?: string }

export type CommitSummary = {
  sha: string
  shortSha: string
  subject: string
  author: string
  relativeDate: string
  // The branches and tags pointing at the commit, as git log --decorate names them.
  refs: string[]
}

// One line of git log --graph: a commit with the lanes drawn left of it, or only lanes joining or splitting.
export type CommitGraphLine = { graph: string; commit: CommitSummary | null; isBoundary: boolean }

export type KeyboardLayout = 'azerty' | 'qwerty' | 'unknown'

export type ViewedState = 'VIEWED' | 'UNVIEWED' | 'DISMISSED'

export type GitHubComment = { author: string; body: string; createdAt: string; url: string }

// An inline review conversation of the pull request on GitHub. An outdated one has lost its line in the current diff.
export type GitHubReviewThread = {
  id: string
  path: string
  side: 'LEFT' | 'RIGHT'
  line: number | null
  originalLine: number | null
  isResolved: boolean
  isOutdated: boolean
  comments: GitHubComment[]
}

export type PullRequestSummary = {
  id: string
  number: number
  url: string
  baseRefName: string | null
  additions: number
  deletions: number
  changedFiles: number
  overviewHeadline: string
  overviewMarkdown: string
}

export type ThreadExchange = { question: string; answer: string; status: 'queued' | 'answering' | 'done' }

export type ReviewThread = {
  id: string
  anchorKey: string
  anchorDescription: string
  exchanges: ThreadExchange[]
  isContextCleared: boolean
}

// Each push and each force push waits for a second press; a push the remote refused offers the force push.
export type PushState = 'idle' | 'armed' | 'pushing' | 'pushed' | 'rejected' | 'forceArmed'

// A failure the notice itself can act on: a refused push offers the force push right where it is reported.
export type ErrorNotice = { id: string; text: string; action: 'forcePush' | null }

// Where a file of the Uncommitted view stands against the index: all of it staged, part of it, or none of it.
export type StageState = 'staged' | 'partlyStaged' | 'unstaged'

export type CommitRequest =
  | { state: 'idle' }
  | { state: 'requested'; headBeforeRequest: string | null; turnId: string | null }
  | { state: 'awaitingReply'; headBeforeRequest: string | null }

declare module 'claude-code' {
  interface PluginState {
    'diff-review': {
      view: ReviewView
      baseRef: string | null
      baseBranchName: string | null
      uncommittedFileCount: number
      stagedFileCount: number
      stageStateByPath: Record<string, StageState>
      // The last git status read, to reload the view only when the working tree changed between two polls.
      workingTreeStatus: string
      commitRequest: CommitRequest
      commitThread: ReviewThread | null
      // The branch's commits since its base, the pull request's one when there is a pull request.
      branchCommitCount: number
      // The branch's commits its remote does not have yet, all of them while the branch was never pushed.
      unpushedCommitShas: string[]
      pushState: PushState
      commitListOffset: number | null
      errorNotices: ErrorNotice[]
      helpScrolledLines: number
      // The thread whose answer the diff follows as it grows, until the person scrolls, moves or changes file.
      followedThreadId: string | null
      commits: CommitSummary[]
      commitGraph: CommitGraphLine[]
      selectedCommitSha: string | null
      // The whole message of the selected commit, its body included.
      selectedCommitMessage: string | null
      files: ChangedFile[]
      selectedFilePath: string | null
      diffRows: DiffRow[]
      loadError: string | null
      threads: ReviewThread[]
      anchorWithOpenInput: string | null
      threadIdByTurnId: Record<string, string>
      threadIdAwaitingTurn: string | null
      questionDraft: string
      hasQuestionHadKeyboard: boolean
      focusedElementKey: string | null
      keyboardLayout: KeyboardLayout
      fileListOffset: number
      diffOffset: number
      // Lines of the first shown row scrolled above the top, kept for the file and the row they were scrolled on.
      diffSkippedLines: { path: string; rowIndex: number; lines: number } | null
      isOverviewShown: boolean
      isLoading: boolean
      repositoryRoot: string | null
      repositoryWebUrl: string | null
      branch: string | null
      fileFilter: string
      watchedTerm: string
      isWatchFieldOpen: boolean
      // The rows of every file of the view, read once a term is watched, so typing it searches them without git.
      watchedSourceRowsByPath: Record<string, DiffRow[]>
      watchedMatchCountByPath: Record<string, number>
      contextLinesByPath: Record<string, number>
      currentThreadId: string | null
      isNoiseShown: boolean
      isViewedHidden: boolean
      recentlyViewedPaths: string[]
      foldedDirectories: string[]
      isFileDrawerOpen: boolean
      isFileListCollapsed: boolean
      isSplitViewPreferred: boolean
      cursorRowIndex: number | null
      isHelpShown: boolean
      answerPulseFrame: number
      claudeCodeTheme: string | null
      // The pane's own Theme setting as it stands now: the options the module got at load keep their first value.
      configuredTheme: string | null
      questionFieldNumber: number
      requestedPaneColumns: number
      fileListWidth: number
      armedQuestion: { anchorKey: string; anchorDescription: string; context: string; threadId?: string } | null
      pullRequest: PullRequestSummary | null
      gitHubReviewThreads: GitHubReviewThread[]
      expandedGitHubThreadIds: string[]
      viewedStateByPath: Record<string, ViewedState>
      pushDismissedPaths: string[]
      renamedPathByPreviousPath: Record<string, string>
    }
  }
}
